verdict.rationale: The pack never mentions connecting a Google or Outlook calendar, and never describes per-meeting-type rules for automatic capture. The closest evidence is organization-wide recording policies and users manually choosing when to record. Those are adjacent controls, not the calendar-driven, per-meeting-type auto-capture rules the story asks for.

support.subject: As a product manager, I connect Google or Outlook calendar once and control per-meeting-type rules for which meetings get captured automatically
